summary: Surgery Partners, Inc. completed the disposition of Mountain View Hospital, LLC and Idaho Falls Community Hospital, LLC, including substantially all assets and certain liabilities, to Intermountain Health on September 14, 2026. The seller received aggregate consideration of approximately $796.6 million, comprising consideration for the business and termination of the company's management agreement with MVH. Two securities purchase agreements dated July 21, 2026, became effective after escrow conditions, including required physician approvals, were satisfied. Proceeds are intended primarily to pay down debt. The close was announced by press release on September 17, 2026, with pro forma financials filed under Item 9.01.
